headline: Thailand Signs New Protocol for Fresh Durian Exports to China
summary: Thailand signed a new protocol updating phytosanitary requirements for fresh durian exports to China as trade value in the sector exceeded $5 billion this year.
why: Durian exports represent a major agricultural trade revenue stream between Thailand and China.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Updated phytosanitary protocols secure access for a multi-billion-dollar agricultural export market.
